title: P17 — Implement portable export/import and offline render
description:
## Dispatch packet P17
Read initiative videoml-dbc2b1 sections D08 before editing. Those are binding decisions, not suggestions.

## Repositories and edit scope
toolchain, cli
Primary paths: bundle schema validation; CLI export/import/render. Read repository AGENTS before any edits. Do not edit unrelated product code.

## Procedure
1. Read prerequisites and existing implementation at the paths above.
2. Add failing behavioral fixtures for the listed acceptance cases.
3. Implement D08 manifest, hashes, pinned assets/fonts/audio/deps and ZIP path validation. Add vml export and import/validate paths, render from frozen bundle; no live network capture. Reject arbitrary hosted dependencies.
4. Run scoped checks plus required repo quality gates. Save actual commands, exit status and artifacts in an issue comment.
5. Return the diff and evidence to the primary reviewer; do not close the issue yourself.

## Acceptance
export fixture renders on clean consumer without Babulus creds; traversal/symlink/hash/version tests; PCM timing parity.

## Dependencies
videoml-684f74 (P02), videoml-48d9c8 (P15), videoml-2779f2 (P04)

## Stop conditions
Do not guess a missing credential/account identity, bypass a failed test, substitute mocked evidence for a real smoke run, expand product scope, or change contract defaults. Report a precise blocker and return to the primary reviewer. A passing build alone is insufficient for rendering behavior.

## Accepted review correction
D08 supports local trusted TS but hosted pilot validation accepts declarative built-in/approved effects only. Exported projects stay portable; report unsupported hosted custom code without mutating the source. Enforce compressed/expanded/file-count/path/hash limits.

comments.text: P15 intentionally does not add a copied source digest that cannot independently validate all normalized source content. P17 must enforce D08 whole-bundle manifest hashes for source/script/frozen timing/audio and reject any mutated file; include narration text and component property tampering tests. This is the full content-integrity boundary, separate from P15 ordered-ID/timing/audio verification.
